items.title: 73243_Joe Thomas oral history interview
items.q: somehow me and Henderson had gotten together, I think it was through Key Johnson.

ctx.x: Because he looks like he could fight instead of play the trumpet ... Charlie always said when we got together, he has a place at 155th street, yeah, Fletcher Henderson, get away from me. Well, in those days here's a guy and I'm sure he's the best now. I'm sure he wouldn't mind it and the unions had guys who were knock out guys in those days. They'd scare you. Deprive you of your rights if you went for it but you could a play a one week anywhere in the world, that's what I was told. So, somehow me and Henderson…
